input.summary: Add a mutual liability cap with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 7
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 waives consequential damages but contains no cap, leaving both parties' direct liability unlimited, so we added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' amounts under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000 — a fixed floor is necessary here because this is a revenue-share arrangement in which Customer pays no fees. Indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and revenue-share payments due under Section 5 are not "damages"; we can discuss the floor amount if needed.

ops.text: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (i) THE AGGREGATE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BETWEEN THE PARTIES UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (ii) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. AMOUNTS PAYABLE UNDER SECTION 5 SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS SECTION 7(b).
